d954mas/defold-box2d/box2d

Box2D physics: worlds, bodies, fixtures, shapes and joints.

  • GitHub: d954mas/defold-box2d — pinned to 1.0.3
    1. Pick a release from d954mas/defold-box2d releases and add its Source code (zip) URL (or a packaged .zip asset, if the library ships one) to game.project under [project] dependencies, then Fetch Libraries in the Defold editor.
    2. Run bunx @defold-typescript/cli resolve to materialize its types.
    3. Import it under a namespace alias of your choice:

NewWorld(gravity?: Vector3): World

Creates a world.

Creates a debug draw to register with {@link World.SetDebugDraw}. Its callbacks run in the script instance that created it; call {@link DebugDraw.Destroy} when it is no longer needed.

Returns

  • DebugDraw — The debug draw.

Types

type ShapeType = typeof b2Shape.e_circle | typeof b2Shape.e_edge | typeof b2Shape.e_polygon | typeof b2Shape.e_chain

type ShapeTable = CircleShapeTable | OneSidedEdgeShapeTable | TwoSidedEdgeShapeTable | BoxShapeTable | PolygonShapeTable | ChainShapeTable

type BoxShapeTable = AxisAlignedBoxShapeTable | OrientedBoxShapeTable

type ChainShapeTable = LoopChainShapeTable | OpenChainShapeTable

type BodyType = typeof b2BodyType.b2_staticBody | typeof b2BodyType.b2_kinematicBody | typeof b2BodyType.b2_dynamicBody

type ManifoldType = typeof b2Manifold_Type.e_circles | typeof b2Manifold_Type.e_faceA | typeof b2Manifold_Type.e_faceB

type JointType = typeof b2JointType.e_unknownJoint | typeof b2JointType.e_revoluteJoint | typeof b2JointType.e_prismaticJoint | typeof b2JointType.e_distanceJoint | typeof b2JointType.e_pulleyJoint | typeof b2JointType.e_mouseJoint | typeof b2JointType.e_gearJoint | typeof b2JointType.e_wheelJoint | typeof b2JointType.e_weldJoint | typeof b2JointType.e_frictionJoint | typeof b2JointType.e_ropeJoint | typeof b2JointType.e_motorJoint

type JointDef = RevoluteJointDef | PrismaticJointDef | DistanceJointDef | PulleyJointDef | MouseJointDef | GearJointDef | WheelJointDef | WeldJointDef | FrictionJointDef | MotorJointDef

Takes a time step: collision detection, integration and constraint solution. Contact listener callbacks run inside it.

World.ClearForces()

Clears the force buffer on all bodies. Forces clear after each step unless {@link World.SetAutoClearForces} turned that off, for sub-stepping.

World.DebugDraw()

Calls the registered debug draw for the shapes and other debug data.

World.RayCast(callback: (this: void, fixture: Fixture, point: Vector3, normal: Vector3, fraction: number) => number, point1: Vector3, point2: Vector3)

Casts a ray against every fixture in its path. The ray ignores shapes that contain its start.

Parameters

  • callback: (this: void, fixture: Fixture, point: Vector3, normal: Vector3, fraction: number) => number — Called for each fixture hit. Return -1 to ignore the fixture, 0 to stop, fraction to clip the ray to this hit, or 1 to continue without clipping.
  • point1: Vector3 — The ray start.
  • point2: Vector3 — The ray end.

World.QueryAABB(callback: (this: void, fixture: Fixture) => boolean, aabb: AABB)

Finds every fixture whose AABB overlaps a box.

Parameters

  • callback: (this: void, fixture: Fixture) => boolean — Called for each fixture. Return true to continue the query, false to stop it.
  • aabb: AABB — The query box.

Vec2

Vec2.x: number

Filter

Filter.categoryBits: number

The collision category bits. Normally one bit is set.

Filter.maskBits: number

The categories this shape accepts for collision.

Filter.groupIndex: number

Objects in the same negative group never collide; in the same positive group they always collide. Zero means no group. A non-zero group wins over the mask bits.

Body.CreateFixture(def: FixtureDef): Fixture

Creates a fixture from a definition and attaches it to this body. If the density is non-zero, the body's mass is updated. Contacts are not created until the next step. Not allowed during callbacks.

  • def: FixtureDef — The fixture definition.

Returns

  • Fixture — The fixture.

Body.CreateFixture(shape: Shape | ShapeTable, density: number): Fixture

  • shape: Shape | ShapeTable — The shape. The fixture gets a copy.
  • density: number — The shape density; zero for a static body.

Returns

  • Fixture — The fixture.

Destroys a fixture, removing it from the broad-phase and destroying its contacts. A dynamic body's mass is adjusted if the fixture had positive density. Not allowed during callbacks.

BodyDef

BodyDef.type?: BodyType

The body type. Default is b2_staticBody. A dynamic body with zero mass gets a mass of one.

BodyDef.position?: Vector3

The world position. Avoid creating bodies at the origin, where shapes overlap.

BodyDef.angle?: number

The world angle in radians.

BodyDef.linearVelocity?: Vector3

The linear velocity of the body's origin in world coordinates.

BodyDef.angularVelocity?: number

The angular velocity.

BodyDef.linearDamping?: number

Reduces the linear velocity. Units are 1/time.

BodyDef.angularDamping?: number

Reduces the angular velocity. Units are 1/time.

BodyDef.allowSleep?: boolean

false keeps the body from sleeping, at a CPU cost. Default is true.

BodyDef.awake?: boolean

Whether the body starts awake. Default is true.

BodyDef.fixedRotation?: boolean

Prevents rotation. Useful for characters.

BodyDef.bullet?: boolean

Prevents a fast dynamic body from tunneling through other moving bodies. Use it sparingly; it costs processing time.

BodyDef.enabled?: boolean

Whether the body starts enabled. Default is true.

BodyDef.userData?: object

Application data. Must be a table.

BodyDef.gravityScale?: number

Scales the gravity applied to this body. Default is 1.
